name: mailpit
title: Mailpit
description: Mailpit catches every e-mail your apps send (SMTP on port 1025, any login accepted) and shows it in a web inbox with HTML, source and spam-score views — the safe way to test mail from Nextcloud, Gitea, n8n or your own code.

variables.name: PORT_MAILPIT_SMTP
variables.label: SMTP port
variables.description: Point your apps' SMTP settings at this port
